comparison: unchanged Smart vs pure P3 only; no P2/P4 hooks
new_case_rule: include every reconstructable Regular-only candidate, list exclusions; no outcome-based replacement

frozen_policy.guards: unlocked Regular full-board sources and placements; no baked geometry or overlays; no Panel Saw

acceptance.manufacturing: complete quantities/identities, physical Kerf, allowed transforms, protected nests, actual JS/strict import
acceptance.paired_boards: no increase in any observed paired trial
acceptance.paired_final_industrial_rank: no regression in any observed paired trial, flag any failure for investigation
acceptance.benefit: repeatable improvement in at least two known cases; do not require improvement in every new case
acceptance.performance: median candidate/baseline wall ratio <=1.10 and maximum paired candidate-minus-baseline <=0.50 sec, measured cooperatively; not a hard 5-second response guarantee
acceptance.metrics: physical cutter network and family/alignment indicators diagnostic, report tradeoffs without changing rank

change_contract.goal: native Smart-only bounded regroup candidate path
change_contract.rollback: remove optional regroup budget passed by Smart; no data migration
